import ty
import path (Path)
import readln (CompletionItem, CompletionLabel)

fn token-end(t: Token) -> Int {
    match t {
        {end, *} => end.byte,
        _        => 0
    }
}

fn token-ends(ts: Array[Token]) -> Array[Int] {
    ts.map!(t -> match t {
        {id, end, *} and end.byte > 0 => end.byte,
        _                             => 0
    })
}

fn parsed-tokens(source: String) -> Array[Token] {
    match ty.parse(source, tokens=true, deep=false, resolve=false) {
        (Ok((_, {tokens, *})) or Err({tokens, *}))
            => tokens.remove!(nil),
        err
            => []
    }
}

fn colored(source: String) -> Array[(String, String)] {
    let parts = [(it, '') for source]
    for i in ..#parts {
        parts[i] = (parts[i][0], 'plain')
    }
    parts
}

fn numbered(lines: Array[String]) -> Array[(Int, String)] {
    lines.enumerate!()
}

fn labelled(names: Array[String], prefix: String) -> Array[CompletionItem] {
    let completions: Array[(CompletionLabel, String)] = []
    for name in names if name.starts?(prefix) {
        let label: CompletionLabel | nil = match name {
            /^_/ => nil,
            _    => [name, ':']
        }
        if label {
            completions.push((label, name[#prefix;]))
        }
    }
    [*completions.sort!(by=\_.1)]
}

fn history-path() -> Path {
    Path.home() / '.ty' / '.history'
}

print(
    token-end(parsed-tokens('let x = 1')[0]),
    token-ends(parsed-tokens('f(1)')),
    colored('ab'),
    numbered(['a', 'b']),
    labelled(['abc', '_x', 'ab'], 'a'),
    "{history-path()}".ends?('.history')
)
